opening.argument: The video documents an ordinary gift-card drawing: the speaker identifies a $50 Toys R Us card and a $25 Panera Bread card as the prizes and refers to “20 spots” with a participant list. The selection is presented as a repeated process, with the speaker stating “Going ten times,” then announcing, “congratulations Brandon ten times ten on the dice and Brandon on top.” Brandon is asked to send unspecified information to Joe, but that instruction does not establish that sensitive data or payment was requested. The available evidence also does not establish deception, delivery, or a completed transaction. On these observable facts, the video shows a promotional drawing and winner-selection process without proof of harmful or fraudulent conduct.
